DEMO — paper-inspired prototypes, not official reproductions
Ground-truth movement was generated by Eclipse SUMO on a passenger-only network converted from OpenStreetMap.
The road map is embedded from the pinned local graph; online tiles are optional.
Geometry is for inspection only; output contracts differ. SUMO passenger graph and the protection models' pinned multimodal OSMnx candidate graph are separate graph builds and are not assumed identical.
